metadata.title: Art Nouveau Floral Border and Dimensional Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A dense Art Nouveau-inspired composition featuring a thick ornamental floral border surrounding a central parchment-like field with heavy, three-dimensional custom lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition defined by a dark, intricate border of stylized sunflowers and acanthus leaves in muted greens and yellows, framing a central light-tan area containing large, drop-shadowed block letters that are partially obscured by floral elements.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark floral border acts as a heavy frame for the lighter central field.
Sunflowers are integrated both into the border and as overlays on the central text.
The 3D depth of the lettering contrasts with the flat, illustrative style of the border.
Acanthus leaves and vines create a rhythmic, symmetrical pattern around the perimeter.
coreInvariants: Symmetrical floral border with sunflowers at corners and midpoints.
Muted palette of olive green, pale yellow, and deep navy/black.
Heavy 3D drop shadows on all central typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The custom lettering occupies the central 60% of the frame, scaled to fill the width of the inner parchment area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, vertically elongated first letter of the top word serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the circular border clockwise before settling on the central text, which is read top-to-bottom in a staggered layout.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is minimal, restricted to the small gaps between the floral elements and the tan background behind the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy or dark charcoal provides the background for the border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale tan/parchment serves as the background for the central text area.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted olive green and dusty yellow define the floral and leaf elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout, creating a vintage, aged appearance with high value contrast between the dark border and light center.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and dark neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed slab-serif or block-style capitals.
letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical elongation on initial characters.
Deep, angled 3D extrusions projecting to the bottom-right.
Internal decorative scrollwork or filigree within the letter faces.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters are significantly larger and more elongated than subsequent characters.
Letters are notched or curved to accommodate overlapping floral illustrations.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom-lettered style used for all text to maintain ornamental consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and ornamental potential of the original.
Captures the era-specific interpretation of Art Nouveau.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square Art Nouveau border featuring stylized sunflowers and acanthus leaves in olive green and muted yellow on a dark navy background, framing a central light-tan parchment area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom 3D block lettering in all-caps with a staggered layout; apply deep drop shadows and place a few sunflower illustrations so they overlap the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the border symmetrical and dense?
Do the letters have a clear 3D extrusion?
Are sunflowers present both in the border and overlapping the text?
Is the color palette muted and vintage?

mustAchieve: Intricate, hand-drawn quality in the border

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite floral overlaps.
Verify the 3D shadows all point in the same direction.
Check that the border maintains a consistent density around the frame.
Confirm the parchment texture is subtle and does not distract from the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Art Nouveau Border + 3D Block Lettering + Floral Overlays + Muted Earth Tones
